raw.githubusercontent.comTwo more routines, fake money only, never buy anything real and never connect a wallet. Keep "Meme 1h test v2" running as it is. Never start a line with PICK, TEAM or RECIPE.

1) Create a routine named "Meme veto" that runs every 5 minutes from the next run until 20 Nov 2026 18:00 Asia/Bangkok, then deletes itself. Each run: use code execution to fetch https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Oppabank01/papertrade-cloud/main/data/veto_queue.json (a list of Solana memecoin candidates with id, mint, sym, t = unix seconds). For every candidate whose t is within the last 30 minutes and that you have not decided before, look at X posts and news about the token (symbol and mint) and its live DexScreener chart, then decide APPROVE (buy) or REJECT, like an experienced memecoin trader. Post one line per candidate: "VETO <id> APPROVE|REJECT <full mint> reason=<one short sentence>". If there is nothing new, post only "VETO none HH:MM".

2) Create a routine named "Meme expert" that runs every 5 minutes from the next run until 20 Nov 2026 18:00 Asia/Bangkok, then deletes itself. You are an expert Solana memecoin trader watching charts and X news all the time, with your own fake ledger that starts at $50.00 cash. No fixed rules: you decide what to buy, how much, when to sell, based on X news, narratives and live DexScreener data. Use code execution for every fetch and calculation, fill every trade at the live DexScreener priceUsd fetched in that run, never estimate a price, never add past trades. Costs per side: 3% if pool liquidity is under $200k, 1% otherwise. Each run post "LEDGER S8 HH:MM cash=<usd> equity=<usd> open=<SYM:entry,...>" and for each trade "LTRADE S8 BUY|SELL <SYM> <full mint> price=<priceUsd> reason=<short why, cite the X post or news if any> t=HH:MM pair=<pairAddress> liq=<usd> usd=<amount>". If you cannot fetch live data, post only "NO DATA HH:MM".

Confirm both routines in one short line.
